title: Anne Frank's diary published
summary: Anne Frank kept a diary from June 1942, mostly while hiding from the Nazis in Amsterdam, until 1 August 1944. Her father Otto edited it, and it was published in 1947 as Het Achterhuis.
why: Translated into more than 70 languages, it gave the Holocaust a single young voice.

notes.problem: She began the diary on 12 June 1942, before the family went into hiding; last entry 1 August 1944.
